title: Second Eye claimClass enumeration
rationale: Frozen G2 acceptance requires one OBSERVED receipt while the live synthetic fixture remains SIMULATED_NOT_OBSERVED. Prior schema/docs only exercised the simulated class. Chair A authorizes a controlled enum expansion; no other fields change.

meanings.SIMULATED_NOT_OBSERVED: Synthetic toy / replay only. No real agent action was observed.
meanings.OBSERVED: One real, bounded agent action was observed under stated conditions. Still not certification, access, or general quality.

nonGoals: Compose with existing genesis.proof-request.v1 / genesis.agent-attestation.v1 shapes
